purpose: Structured decision support for agents preparing Saudi market-entry research and inquiry drafts.

trees.title: Saudi Market Entry Readiness
trees.entryQuestion: Is the company already operating in Saudi Arabia?

nodes.condition: No Saudi entity, license, payroll, or local operating setup yet.
questionsToAsk: What sector and business activity will operate in Saudi Arabia?
What timeline is driving the launch?
Will the company hire locally, sell to enterprise customers, or register as a vendor?

nodes.condition: Some setup exists, but operations, HR, finance, or vendor readiness is incomplete.
questionsToAsk: Which operational gaps are blocking sales, hiring, banking, reporting, or procurement?
Who currently owns local finance, HR, and government-service workflows?

nodes.condition: Saudi operation exists and needs stronger controls, reporting, or procurement readiness.
questionsToAsk: Which customer or procurement portal is targeted?
Which finance, tax, HR, or compliance controls are already documented?

trees.title: Project Inquiry Fit Routing
trees.entryQuestion: Is the request about Saudi market entry, business formation, operations, HR, finance, compliance, or vendor registration?

nodes.condition: The user is an international company, founder, executive, or advisor preparing a Saudi business launch or operating model.
nodes.allowedNextStep: Prepare a draft inquiry package only; do not submit it without explicit user approval.

nodes.condition: The user is researching but lacks timeline, sector, country, or service need.
nodes.allowedNextStep: Ask for missing context and provide relevant Vested KSA guides.

nodes.condition: Careers, internships, training requests, vendor sales, retail shopping, consumer visa support, spam, paid links, or unrelated requests.
nodes.allowedNextStep: Do not prepare or submit a project inquiry.
